overview.playstyle: You are a health-stacking bruiser who wins by being unkillable and hard to ignore. Farm safely, throw Infected Bonesaw (Q) to heal and poke, then stack Heartsteel and Warmog's Armor. Around 2000 bonus health you out-sustain most top laners, split-push relentlessly and force the enemy to answer you.

seasonNotes: 26.19 (current): no Dr. Mundo changes. His last change was 26.8.
26.8: Infected Bonesaw monster damage cap 300/375/450/525/600 -> 250/325/400/475/550; Blunt Force Trauma monster damage 200% -> 140%. Jungle clear is slower, top lane is unaffected.

26.17: Base stat buffs listed in the patch notes (health 522 -> 560, health growth 89 -> 90, level 1 attack speed 0.625 -> 0.658). The notes place them in the Classic section, so treat them as uncertain for normal Summoner's Rift; the notes call him one of the worst top laners and junglers before this.
26.11: Heartsteel Colossal Consumption converts 10% of its damage into permanent health (was 8%).

26.1 (season start): Role Quests. Top quest gives +600 XP, +11% XP, level cap 20 and a free Unleashed Teleport (390 s cooldown as of 26.19). If you run Teleport it becomes a shielded Teleport with 30 s lower cooldown.
26.1: Minions spawn 0:30, Atakhan removed, Baron at 20:00, plates permanent, melee deals 20% more damage to turrets (good for your split push).
26.16 + 26.17: Sundered Sky nerfed (health 450 -> 400, AD 45 -> 40). Not a Mundo item, but it makes enemy bruisers slightly less scary.

voidgrubs.notes: 3 Voidgrubs, no respawn, despawn at 14:45. Each gives a structure-burn stack; a strong split-push tool for you.

riftHerald.notes: Despawns 19:45. Use the Eye of the Herald top to take plates and turret.

elderDragon.spawn: After a team secures Dragon Soul (4th drake)

objectiveTimers.otherNotes: Atakhan no longer exists. Minions spawn 0:30, jungle camps 0:55.

abilities.name: Goes Where He Pleases
abilities.summary: Periodically you are immune to immobilizing effects. Resisting one costs 4% current health and drops a canister that heals 4% max health. You also gain health regeneration by level.
tips: Walk through the first root, stun or snare; the canister heals you back.
Pick up the canister right away to get the heal.
Do not count on it twice in a row: the immunity has a cooldown.

abilities.name: Infected Bonesaw
abilities.summary: Throw a bonesaw that deals magic damage as a percentage of target current health and slows. You heal for your health cost on champions and monsters (half on other units).
tips: Aim it: land it on champions to heal back what it cost.
Hit it on the minion in front of the enemy to line up the slow and poke.
Use it on low-health minions to farm, it costs health so watch your HP.
Best poke and chase tool, also good to kite a diver.

abilities.name: Heart Zapper
abilities.summary: Charge a defibrillator for up to 3 s: it damages nearby enemies over time and stores about 80-95% of the damage you take. Recast to detonate for area magic damage and heal based on stored damage.
tips: Turn it on before an enemy burst combo, then recast to heal it back.
Also clears waves and jungle camps quickly.
Recast right before a stun would kill you.

abilities.name: Blunt Force Trauma
abilities.summary: Passive: bonus attack damage from max health. Active: next attack gets bonus range and damage that scales with your missing health, and launches minions and monsters it kills.
tips: Trade with E when you are missing health: it hits harder as you lose HP.
Use E on the last hit to launch a minion into the enemy for extra damage.
Max damage after you have been poked down.

abilities.name: Maximum Dosage
abilities.summary: For 10 s you regain health based on your missing health, gain bonus movement speed and huge health regeneration.
tips: Pop it when you start a fight or dive, not when you are almost dead.
Use the speed to chase, catch or walk out of a fight.
Combine with W stored damage for a huge sustain window.

combos.name: Poke trade
combos.when: Enemy steps up to a last hit; land Q for the slow and heal.

combos.name: Short trade
combos.when: After landing Q you can hit E and follow up; go when the enemy is low or has used a cooldown.

combos.name: Sustain trade
combos.input: W on > Q > E > AA > W recast
combos.when: Enemy will burst you; W stores their damage and heals it back.

combos.name: All-in
combos.when: Level 6+, you are ahead or the enemy is low; R gives speed and regen to finish the chase.

combos.name: Wave clear
combos.input: W on wave > Q low minions > E last hit
combos.when: Fast clear to reach a side lane or to reset before a fight.

combos.name: Disengage
combos.when: Enemy dives you or you are chased: slow, then R for speed and regen.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying (default)
runes.when: Default in almost every matchup (79% of games on OP.GG, 50.44% WR; 51.62% WR on Lolalytics). Skill Capped uses Biscuit Delivery as the second Inspiration rune. Verify minor rune picks in the client, they vary slightly by source.

runes.name: Grasp of the Undying + Doran's Shield (vs ranged / poke)
runes.when: Against ranged or poke lanes: keep Grasp, but choose Second Wind for sustain and Biscuit Delivery for early healing. Judgment page built from the source data; no win rate published for it.

summoners.when: Default on OP.GG (49.46% pick, 49.61% WR). Ghost lets you catch or escape; Teleport gets you back to lane. Your top quest upgrades Teleport with a shield.
Lolalytics standard: more kill pressure in lane against squishier or ranged champions.
Vs ranged bullies where you lose HP and need to return to lane; Flash is safer against burst.

skillOrder.notes: OP.GG most common: Q E W Q Q R Q E Q E R E E W W (Q maxed first, then E, W last). Lolalytics and Skill Capped start E first and level Q at 2-3, then max Q or E. R at 6/11/16. Take W at level 1 only when farming a jungle-style clear is needed.

startingItems.when: Default (Lolalytics): extra health and regeneration into most lanes.
Vs ranged or poke tops: block damage and sustain. Not a published top pick, use as judgment.

firstItemOptions.when: Default first legendary: build Giant's Belt and Bami's Cinder components, then stack it in lane by hitting the enemy when you are close.
Vs heavy early AD or melee all-in lanes where you need armor before health stacking pays off; Heartsteel second.

boots.when: Default (Mobalytics, Lolalytics, Skill Capped): buy after you reach about 2000 bonus HP.
Vs heavy AD or auto-attack champions.
Vs heavy CC or AP damage.

firstBackBuys.buy: Giant's Belt - first step to Heartsteel.
Kindlegem - Heartsteel component; add a Ruby Crystal or Control Ward with leftover gold.
Giant's Belt + Ruby Crystal - more health for lane sustain and Heartsteel stacks.

items.name: Heartsteel
items.why: Permanent health from hits; your standard first item, 900 health and 10% conversion since 26.11.

items.name: Warmog's Armor
items.why: Huge health and regen once you have 2000 bonus HP; your second item.

items.name: Titanic Hydra
items.why: Damage from max health, cleave and wave clear; 63% WR as 4th item on Lolalytics.

items.name: Spirit Visage
items.why: Magic resistance and increased healing that boosts your Q and W heals.

items.name: Thornmail
items.why: Armor and Grievous Wounds on anyone who hits you.

items.name: Sunfire Aegis
items.why: Health and armor plus constant area damage; good if you want an early tank item.

items.name: Force of Nature
items.why: Magic resistance and movement speed against repeated magic damage.

items.name: Randuin's Omen
items.why: Armor, health and a slow aura against crit marksmen and fast melee.

items.name: Frozen Heart
items.why: Armor and attack speed reduction against auto-attackers.

items.name: Jak'Sho, The Protean
items.why: Adds armor and magic resistance that grows in long fights; healing scales well on you.

items.name: Sterak's Gage
items.why: Big shield, health and tenacity against assassins.

items.name: Gargoyle Stoneplate
items.why: Armor, magic resistance and extra health for the frontline in a big fight.

items.name: Guardian Angel
items.why: Revive when you are the frontline.

items.name: Dead Man's Plate
items.why: Armor, health and movement speed for splitting and running down side lanes.

items.name: Boots of Swiftness
items.why: Default boots: movement speed for split-pushing and running to lane; buy at about 2000 bonus HP.

items.name: Plated Steelcaps
items.why: Reduces auto-attack damage against AD carries and fighters.

items.name: Mercury's Treads
items.why: Tenacity and magic resistance versus CC and AP teams.

items.name: Bami's Cinder
items.why: Component of Sunfire Aegis: health and burn for wave clear when you go Sunfire first.

powerSpikes.what: Weak early. Do not fight ranged champions; use Q to farm and sustain and heal back with the slow.
Q, E and W together: first real trade window when you land Q.
R gives speed and regen: you can now win duels and walk out of ganks.
First item spike: stack it on the enemy laner and start pushing lane.
Regen kicks in: you are very hard to kill, split-push and dive.

powerSpikes.when: Top role quest done (about 13:35 at the latest)
powerSpikes.what: +600 XP, level cap 20 and a free Teleport: use it for Herald at 15:00 or drakes.
You are a full frontline and split-push threat: force fights or push side lanes.
